quote: A call to `retain` that returns `Unit` is always an error.
note: androidx 官方 retain-lint 原始碼的 RetainUnitType 說明:retain 回傳 Unit 是錯,改用 SideEffect(或 RetainedEffect)。DoNotRetain 官方 API 頁另說明 RetainingDoNotRetainType 的出處。型錄寫 LaunchedEffect 為標準寫法,官方原文寫的是 SideEffect/RetainedEffect,方向一致但 LaunchedEffect 字面未出現。

quote: CompositionLocal properties should be prefixed with `Local`.
note: androidx 官方 lint 與 compose-rules 都明講 Local 前綴,範例 val LocalFoo = compositionLocalOf { Foo() }。

quote: `CompositionLocal`s should be singletons and not use getters. Otherwise a new instance will be returned every call.
note: 原文支持核心主張。注意:這條規則出自 Slack compose-lints,不是 androidx;型錄「現成規則」欄的 androidx: 前綴應改成 slack:。

quote: Composable functions should either emit layout content, or return a value, but not both.
note: compose-rules 與 Slack compose-lints 原文一致。

quote: A composable function should emit either 0 or 1 pieces of layout, but no more.
note: 兩份官方規則文件原文一致;包 Column 的解法為型錄補充,原文講的是只發 0 或 1 個節點。

quote: Composable functions with only one composable lambda parameter should use the name `content` for the parameter.
note: androidx lint 原始碼說明,API 指南也寫「usually named `content`」。

quote: Use `remember { movableContentOf { ... } }` to make sure the content is preserved correctly
note: compose-rules 的 Content Slot Reused 一節;Slack 文件另寫 Invoke a slot at most once on each execution path。

quote: putting the mandatory parameters first, followed by the optional ones (aka the ones with default values).
note: API 指南列出順序:必填、單一 modifier、選填、結尾 content lambda,與型錄一致。

quote: we'll want to adjust the tense of the verbs to present.
note: compose-rules ParameterNaming 一節要求事件參數用 on+現在式動詞(onShow、onChange),與型錄一致。

quote: should have the `Composable` suffix (for example, `@GoogleMapComposable` or `@MosaicComposable`).
note: compose-rules 該節原文。

quote: this object should have the same visibility as the composable itself.
note: compose-rules 原文;API 指南另要求預設值要公開可用。

quote: material components will not pick up the correct content color from a material3 container, and vice versa.
note: androidx 官方 lint 說明兩套是互不相容的設計系統,混用會主題/內容色不一致;compose-rules 也寫 M3 取代 M2。

quote: consider providing separate `@Composable` functions named differently to signify the difference in styling and use cases.
note: 官方 API 指南建議以不同命名的獨立 composable 表達樣式差異(OutlinedButton、TextButton 為例)。原文未直接點名「布林旗標」,但標準寫法與型錄一致。

quote: Use `ComponentDefaults` objects to name-space defaults values if you have a number of them.
note: 指南的 ButtonColors 範例即 ButtonDefaults.colors() 工廠函式,與型錄標準寫法一致。

quote: If this parameter is ignored, then content may be obscured by the app bars resulting in visual issues
note: androidx 官方 lint 說明,後果(被 app bar 擋住)與型錄一致。

quote: Not using the input parameter to the content lambda will result in the same content for different input
note: AnimatedContent 與 Crossfade 的官方 lint 說明皆寫不用參數會導致不同狀態出同一內容、轉場錯誤。

quote: generally considered an error if this `targetState` parameter is not used.
note: 官方 lint 說明:targetState 參數可能與實際狀態不同,不用會造成錯誤與多餘重組。型錄後果寫「動畫不動」略強,原文講的是值算錯與預覽/seek 失準。

quote: ArcAnimationSpec is designed for 2D values. Particularly, for positional values such as Offset.
note: 官方 lint 說明,後果原文為「unpredictable animation behavior」,型錄寫「無效果」稍有出入,方向一致。

quote: If this scope is ignored, then the cost of subcomposition is being wasted and this BoxWithConstraints
note: 官方 lint 說明,後半句為 should be replaced with a Box。

quote: it doesn’t need to have public visibility because it won’t be used in actual UI.
note: Slack compose-lints 原文;compose-rules 寫 we should restrict its visibility to `private`。

quote: Multipreview annotations should use `Previews` as a prefix (e.g., `@PreviewsLightDark`).
note: 型錄標準寫法是 Previews 當後綴(DarkLightPreviews)。compose-rules(CR)現行文件寫前綴(@PreviewsLightDark,與 Google 內建 @PreviewLightDark 風格同向),只有 Slack 版寫 suffix。兩個來源互相矛盾,型錄跟了 Slack、與 CR 相反,應改成可設定或擇一並註明出處。

quote: By default, enabling this rule will make sure that previews use `Preview` as suffix.
note: compose-rules 的 opt-in 規則,可設 suffix、prefix、anywhere 策略,與型錄「依設定策略統一」一致。

quote: Use a localized string, as it is visible to the user.
note: 官方頁面示範 IconButton 內 Icon 用 stringResource 當 contentDescription,並說明框架無法自行理解圖示內容;null 僅用於純裝飾元素。

quote: Use a localized string, as it is visible to the user.
note: 官方原文要求 contentDescription 用在地化字串,範例為 stringResource(R.string.label_share)。

quote: make sure to set the minimum size to 48dp to correctly follow the Material Design accessibility guidelines.
note: 官方頁面同時介紹 minimumInteractiveComponentSize;測試頁說明 enableAccessibilityChecks 的 ATF 會檢查 small touch target size。

quote: Use the `Role` semantics property (like `Role.Button` or `Role.Switch`) to expose a UI element's type.
note: apps 頁講 Role 暴露元件型別;principles 頁講 onClickLabel 可提供點擊動作的描述。

quote: Use the parent container's `semantics` modifier to set `mergeDescendants` to `true`.
note: 官方頁面說明把相關元素放進父容器並 mergeDescendants,讓讀屏一次唸完,與型錄一致。

quote: It is recommend you use this unit when specifying font sizes, so they will be adjusted for both the screen density and the user's preference.
note: 官方資源文件講文字大小用 sp 才會隨使用者字級偏好縮放(原文 recommend 為官方拼法)。型錄後半「固定高度截字、改 heightIn」未找到逐字原文,核心 sp 主張已有出處。

quote: use foreground and background colors that result in a color contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.
note: 官方原文給對比門檻(小於 18sp 需 4.5:1,其餘 3:1);測試頁說明 ATF 檢查含 color contrast。「用主題色 onSurface」未逐字出現,但主題色角色配對屬型錄補充。

quote: To enable this, indicate that your component is a heading by defining its semantics property
note: 官方頁面說明用 Modifier.semantics { heading() },讓無障礙服務可在標題間跳轉,與型錄一致。
